key_developments: Pan Zhiming predicts that in the second half of 2026, the number of industrial and commercial property transactions will reach 2,340, with average prices falling by less than 10% and total value around HK$266 bn.
The first half of 2026 saw 2,562 industrial and commercial property deals, a 15% rise in volume but a 7% drop in total value to HK$287.7 bn, marking the highest transaction count in four years.
Forecasts for the second half of 2026 project a modest 3.8% increase in transaction count to 2,660 and an 11.2% rise in value to HK$320 bn, suggesting a rebound in market activity.
The forecasted price decline is set against a backdrop of US rate hikes and Mainland capital outflow restrictions, adding uncertainty to the market.
